description: React component implementing the Draft Persona client UI, managing state, fetching/saving drafts, regeneration, and finalization workflows in a Next.js app.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out empty values.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various input shapes into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects.

methods.name: looksLikePersonaDraftSchema
methods.description: Type guard to identify if an object matches the PersonaDraftSchema shape.

methods.name: looksLikeLegacyDraft
methods.description: Type guard to identify if an object matches the LegacyDraftPersona shape.

methods.name: toEditableModel

methods.name: applyEditsToDraft

methods.name: fetchLatestPersistedDraft
